top_choice_rationale: Ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling solved a distinct mechanistic problem (amido formation, slow C-N reductive elimination, beta-hydride competition) by ligand design, giving a general method with about thirty years of independent validation and routine use in pharmaceutical and process chemistry. The Buchwald and Hartwig allocation is clean and the citation scope is precise, so P001 has neither a maturity nor a credit problem. P004 follows because pKa-tuned ionizable lipids are a real molecular design principle, although the Cullis-Hope-Madden cut leaves a priority dispute. P003 and P002 come next, ahead of no award.
